stops.name: Farthest North Spruce wayside
stops.source: Read: Farthest North Spruce Wayside, Dalton Highway milepost 235, OSM way 692147972 (highway=rest_area, large_vehicles=yes, toilets=yes, opening_hours=24/7), OpenStreetMap planet extract 2026-11-16. Tractor-trailer access read from its large_vehicles tag. Sleep: Alaska's rule for rest stops and pullouts on the state highway system, 17 AAC 05.045 (read from https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/alaska/17-AAC-05.045), limits parking only to what is posted; no posted limit under 10 hours at this site is assumed, not verified. Open in winter is assumed: the BLM 2024 Dalton Highway Visitor Guide says the road is maintained year round but names no wayside plowing. Leg mile projected onto the leg's road.
